title: Patch: route six held-set hooks through the engine's read helpers instead of `GameState` fields
thread:
**Issue #4937 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #4937: Patch: route six held-set hooks through the engine's read helpers instead of `GameState` fields
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

Card scripts are supposed to read the board only through the engine's read helpers, never raw state fields. Six newer scripts read the raw state directly. The game plays the same either way, but the six contradict the documented contract and will mislead the next person who copies them. This swaps each read for its helper with no behavior change.

## Why

crates/cards/README.md (section 1) states a hook may read the state only through the engine's read helpers, never a `GameState` field: no script names `state.players[...]` above its `#[cfg(test)]`. Six hooks in the held set do exactly that, all above their test modules: c174_scrape_the_graveyard.rs:17, c175_fingerprinter.rs:19, c177_predictive_text.rs:21-22, c184_pattern_recognition.rs:97, c186_identity_theft.rs:17, c188_overfitting.rs:60. Every other repo-wide hit was checked per file and sits below `#[cfg(test)]` (test code, which the contract allows), e.g. c035_rollback.rs:157,871,1031, t_coin.rs:106,327, c045_knowledge_breaker.rs:144,244, c207_recursive_self_improvement.rs:112,117,118. Each has an existing helper spelling: `zone_cards` (Graveyard/Hand/Library), `zone_count` (Hand), and `fill_board_zones` (already used by meditative/c097_9, crates/engine/src/zones.rs).

## Proposal

Mechanical swaps: graveyard/hand/library reads to `zone_cards` with the matching `OffFieldZone`, the two hand `.len()` reads to `zone_count`, and the empty-zone scan to `fill_board_zones`. No logic changes.

## Where it lands

The six files under crates/cards/src/scripts/infinite_assault/. No spec change (behavior identical).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] No `state.players` read above `#[cfg(test)]` in those six files
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-cards infinite_assault` green
- [ ] `cargo clippy -p jackioh-cards --all-targets -- -D warnings` green

## Size and risks

S. Zero behavior risk: purely mechanical, covered by the cards' existing base/Radiant tests.

Class: `refactor` → `priority:low`; relabel to change it.

## Plan

_Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/45682827978)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Swap six raw `state.players[…]` reads in held-set card scripts for the engine's read helpers with zero behavior change. Done means no `state.players` read above `#[cfg(test)]` in those six files, the cards' existing base/Radiant tests green, and clippy green.

## Files to touch

| File | New/change | What changes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `crates/cards/src/scripts/infinite_assault/c174_scrape_the_graveyard.rs` | change | `scrape()` cry hook (lines 17–21): graveyard read → `zone_cards` with `OffFieldZone::Graveyard` |
| `crates/cards/src/scripts/infinite_assault/c175_fingerprinter.rs` | change | base cry hook (lines 19–24): hand read → `zone_cards` with `OffFieldZone::Hand` |
| `crates/cards/src/scripts/infinite_assault/c177_predictive_text.rs` | change | `ForEachCardArgs` cards closure (lines 21–22): two hand `.len()` reads → `zone_count` with `OffFieldZone::Hand` |
| `crates/cards/src/scripts/infinite_assault/c184_pattern_recognition.rs` | change | `STEP_RADIANT` resume hook (lines 97–102): library read → `zone_cards` with `OffFieldZone::Library` |
| `crates/cards/src/scripts/infinite_assault/c186_identity_theft.rs` | change | cry hook (lines 17–21): hand read → `zone_cards` with `OffFieldZone::Hand` |
| `crates/cards/src/scripts/infinite_assault/c188_overfitting.rs` | change | `with_when` gate (lines 60–63): empty-zone scan → `fill_board_zones` |

Must not touch: `crates/engine/`, `crates/ai/`, `spec/`, catalog files, or anything under `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`. Governing contract: `crates/cards/README.md` §1 "The read surface" (helpers only, never a `GameState` field) and CLAUDE.md rules 4–5. No spec change: spec §8.13 rows 174, 175, 177, 184, 186, 188 are context only, card texts and behavior unchanged, so no ruling note.

## Steps

All helpers are already in the prelude (`pub use crate::query::*` and `pub use crate::zones::*` in `crates/engine/src/prelude.rs`), so no import changes in any file. Copy the call shapes from `crates/cards/src/scripts/classic/c026_rapid_draw.rs` (`zone_cards`), `crates/cards/src/scripts/classic/c009_income_tax.rs` (`zone_count`), and `crates/cards/src/scripts/meditative/c097_9_jlockeeds_headquarters.rs` line 38 (`fill_board_zones`).

1. In `c174_scrape_the_graveyard.rs`, `scrape()`, replace lines 17–21 `ctx.state.players[opp].graveyard.iter().map(…)` with `zone_cards(&*ctx.state, opp, OffFieldZone::Graveyard).iter().map(|c| c.id.clone()).collect()`; keep the `to_take` shuffle/take logic untouched.
2. In `c175_fingerprinter.rs`, base cry hook, replace `ctx.state.players[opp].hand.iter()` with `zone_cards(&*ctx.state, opp, OffFieldZone::Hand).iter()`; keep the `.filter(|c| card_type_of(&*ctx.state, c) == CardType::Spell).map(|c| c.id.clone())` chain byte-identical (iterator item types are unchanged).
3. In `c177_predictive_text.rs`, cards closure, replace `each.state.players[opp].hand.len()` with `zone_count(each.state, opp, OffFieldZone::Hand)` and `each.state.players[each.controller].hand.len()` with `zone_count(each.state, each.controller, OffFieldZone::Hand)`; keep the `opp_hand > my_hand` comparison (`i32` vs `i32`).
4. In `c184_pattern_recognition.rs`, `STEP_RADIANT` hook, replace `ctx.state.players[opp].library.iter().take(3).map(…)` with `zone_cards(&*ctx.state, opp, OffFieldZone::Library).iter().take(3).map(|c| c.id.clone()).collect()`; order is preserved (`query.rs` documents `library[0]` on top).
5. In `c186_identity_theft.rs`, cry hook, replace `ctx.state.players[opp].hand.iter()` with `zone_cards(&*ctx.state, opp, OffFieldZone::Hand).iter()`; keep the `.map(|c| (c.id.clone(), c.def_id.clone(), c.radiant))` tuple chain.
6. In `c188_overfitting.rs`, `with_when` gate, replace the three lines `&& ctx.state.players[ctx.controller].units.iter().any(|pile| pile.is_none())` with `&& !fill_board_zones(ctx.state, ctx.controller).is_empty()`; keep the `*player !=`, `played_type_of`, `*permanent`, and `left_field_since_resolved` clauses.
7. Run `grep -rn 'state\.players'` on the six full paths and confirm zero hits above each file's `#[cfg(test)]` line (test modules use the testkit's `s.state().players`, which does not match and is allowed).

## Tests

No new tests: the refactor is behavior-identical and each file's existing base/Radiant tests are the proof (c174 adds-copies/empty-graveyard, c175 `r4592001_*`, c177 draw-counts, c184 `r4592004_*`, c186 shuffles-and-draws, c188 summon-copy tests). Commands:

- `cargo test -p jackioh-cards infinite_assault`
- `cargo clippy -p jackioh-cards --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- `cargo fmt --check`

## Done when

- [ ] No `state.players` read above `#[cfg(test)]` in the six files (grep-clean)
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-cards infinite_assault` green
- [ ] `cargo clippy -p jackioh-cards --all-targets -- -D warnings` green
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check` green
- [ ] No other file changed; no spec, catalog, or engine edit

## Risks

- `fill_board_zones` (empty, unreserved, non-hole unit zones per `crates/engine/src/zones.rs:1856`) is stricter than the raw any-empty-pile check: they differ only with a reserved zone (Reborn-held, animated home) or a hole. Avoid by keeping the prescribed spelling anyway: `summon_copy` with `lane: None` places through the same `takes_move`-based scan, so the two agree wherever the summon can actually land, and the existing base/Radiant tests cover the normal case.
- `zone_cards` clones the pile; iterating the temporary and the `&&CardInstance` filter coercion in c175 behave exactly as before. No determinism, replay, or hidden-information impact: copies, not live piles, in the same zone order.

## Open questions

None.
```
